sections.name: We step in where the second chance starts.
sections.html:
Our Mission

We step in where the second chance starts.

Violet Initiative exists to give dogs at North District Parish Animal Services the opportunity they may not get otherwise. As a 100% volunteer-based nonprofit, every dollar is directed toward helping animals who need care, transport, visibility, and a safe path forward.

sections.name: Meet your familys next best friend.
sections.html:
Open Your Home

Meet your familys next best friend.

Fostering gives a dog safety, stability, and the time they need to be seen. It is one of the fastest ways to create space, save lives, and help a dog become ready for forever.

Apply to Foster

block_1.media_1_alt: Open your home for a week
block_1.heading_1: Open your home for a week
block_1.text_1: Short-term fosters give dogs a break from the shelter — and give us time to find them the right forever home.

block_2.text_1: Some dogs arrive with medical needs. Foster carers who can follow a simple care routine save lives every time.

block_3.media_1_alt: Be part of the moment they find their family
block_3.heading_1: Be part of the moment they find their family
block_3.text_1: Fosters are there for the transport day, the adoption call, the moment everything changes. It stays with you.

sections.name: Two direct ways your gift saves lives.
sections.html:
Featured Campaigns

Two direct ways your gift saves lives.

block_1.text_1: Every transport gives a dog a shot at rescue. $40 covers a single dog ride to a partner rescue or approved adopter.

block_2.text_1: Dogs arrive with injuries, illness, and untreated pain. Your gift goes directly to vet bills for animals in crisis.

content.heading_1: Two direct ways your gift saves lives.

sections.name: Some dogs arrive with stories they cannot tell.
sections.html:
From Crisis to Care

Some dogs arrive with stories they cannot tell.

Road rash, illness, neglect, and urgent medical needs can make a dog easy to overlook in an overcrowded shelter. Violet Initiative helps turn those moments into treatment, recovery, and a future.

Help Fund Recovery
